visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short, dark hair and black-framed glasses speaks directly into the camera in a close-up shot. She is wearing a beige hoodie over a dark inner shirt, set against a plain, textured ceiling background. (2) The camera cuts to a POV shot of a large green shopping bag resting on the floor. Inside, several items are visible, including a large pack of white toilet paper with a green foot logo, yellow bags of snacks, and a box of Pocky. (3) The woman returns to the frame with a distressed expression, looking slightly away from the lens. This is followed by an extreme close-up focusing strictly on her eyes behind her glasses, showing a blank, frustrated stare. (4) She holds up a cardboard box of I-Mei milk ice bars, her facial expression conveying worry and realization as she looks at the product. (5) Standing in a hallway with white tiled walls, she uses her right hand to pat her forehead repeatedly in a self-correcting or regretful gesture. (6) She is seen shaking a vertical-slatted metal security gate, attempting to open it without success. (7) Squatting on the tiled floor of the corridor next to a wall-mounted red fire extinguisher, she opens a box of Pocky and begins eating a chocolate-covered stick. (8) She leans her head tiredly against a metal handrail in the hallway, looking upwards with a weary expression. (9) She holds a single red bean ice bar wrapped in plastic towards the camera, then unwraps it and begins to eat it while still in the hallway. (10) Finally, the scene cuts to her opening a wooden door from the outside, her face lighting up with a wide, joyful laugh as she enters the dark interior of her home.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents a relatable and humorous daily misfortune: the creator forgot her house keys after a major grocery trip, leaving her stranded in the hallway with melting ice cream. The core appeal lies in her comedic reaction to the situation, choosing to eat the snacks and ice cream while waiting for help, turning a frustrating moment into a lighthearted vlog.
